nodes.name: fortran_orm_error
nodes.doc:
@brief Unified error status enumeration returned by every function in
fortran-orm (`FORTRAN_ORM_OK == 0`).

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_NOT_FOUND
variants.doc: @brief Requested row or key not found (`C_ORM_ERROR_NOT_FOUND`).

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_IO
variants.doc: @brief File or OS CSPRNG I/O error (`C_ORM_ERROR_IO`).

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_PARSE
variants.doc: @brief SQL, JSON, or schema parse failure (`C_ORM_ERROR_PARSE`).

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_DECIMAL_SYNTAX
variants.doc:
@brief Invalid decimal string or BCD nybble
(`C_ORM_ERROR_DECIMAL_SYNTAX`).

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
variants.doc: @brief Null, closed, or corrupted Fortran FFI handle or slot ID.

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_HANDLE_TABLE_FULL
variants.doc: @brief Legacy integer handle slot table capacity exhausted.

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL
variants.doc: @brief Caller array/matrix capacity smaller than result count.

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_INVALID_INDEX
variants.doc: @brief 1-based parameter, column, or row index out of valid bounds.

variants.name: FORTRAN_ORM_ERROR_INVALID_OPCODE
variants.doc: @brief Unrecognized FORTRAN I / legacy dispatcher opcode.

layout: 44 bytes, natural 4-byte alignment).

fields.name: sign
fields.doc: @brief `0` for non-negative, `1` for negative (`0` is always `0`).

fields.name: digits
fields.doc: @brief Unpacked base-10 digits (`0..9`), least-significant at index `0`.

fields.name: reserved
fields.doc: @brief Explicit reserved padding bytes (`0`) for 44-byte ABI alignment.

fields.name: exhaustion_count
fields.doc: @brief Cumulative count of pool exhaustion events.

fields.name: average_wait_time_ms
fields.doc: @brief Moving average acquisition wait time in milliseconds.

fields.name: slow_queries_logged
fields.doc: @brief Cumulative count of queries exceeding slow-query threshold.
